name: Select
description: Chooses one value from a short list with the native select element. It shares the Input field anatomy; searchable and rich options are the Combobox family (#54).

props.name: options
props.description: The options: strings, or { value, label, disabled } objects. Option children (a slot in Blade and Vue) render as well, after them.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the control, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required, shows the required mark and makes the placeholder option unselectable.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The empty first option, shown in the muted color while it's selected. Translated by default.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected value. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled select.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name before the value, resolved through the icon registry. A slot or node overrides it.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { label: '…', control: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, box, hint and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the control is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered box around the control, its icon and the chevron.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native select. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: indicator
parts.description: The chevron. It points down in every direction.

events.name: value-change
events.description: The selected value changed. React and Vue pass the matching option's value as given (a number stays a number); option children and Livewire give the string.

keyboard.action: Closes the list and keeps the value.

requirements: Uses the native select element, so the platform supplies the listbox, keyboard and screen-reader support.
The label is always visible and linked with for/id.
Hint and error are linked to the control with aria-describedby; invalid sets aria-invalid.
The placeholder is an empty option in the muted color, so it never looks like a value; it can't be chosen when required.
Class goes to the root; every other attribute (wire:model, name) goes to the control.
Visible focus ring on the box while the control has :focus-visible.
The chevron doesn't mirror under RTL; the icon and chevron swap sides with the text direction.
